author: hyunback
title: Android CMake configure fails: plugin MODULE_LIBRARY targets cannot be linked
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue
key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target.
root_cause: The CMake configure step for both x64 and arm64 Android builds fails with the same error: plugin targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_auto_batch_plugin, openvino_hetero_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_intel_npu_plugin) are of type MODULE_LIBRARY but are being passed to target_link_libraries in plugins.cmake:275. This is invoked from ov_generate_plugins_hpp -> ov_target_link_plugins. The PR #37064 changes GPU plugin files (paged_attention_opt.cl and paged_attention_opt.cpp) which likely altered a CMake property or registration for the GPU plugin target, causing the ov_add_plugin macro to register it differently. Alternatively, a CMakeLists.txt change in the PR inadvertently changed target type for one or more plugins.
reproduction_steps: Run CMake configure for the Android target with the PR's head commit. Look at how ov_add_plugin is invoked in src/plugins/intel_gpu/CMakeLists.txt.
recommended_actions: Review the changes in src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/graph/impls/ocl_v2/paged_attention_opt.cpp for any CMakeLists.txt side effects
Check if any CMakeLists.txt in the GPU plugin subtree was modified by the PR
Examine plugins.cmake:275-327 to understand when ov_target_link_plugins is called with MODULE targets
Revert the PR and confirm the Android build succeeds to confirm PR caused the regression
prevention_strategies: Include Android CMake configure as a required check for GPU plugin PRs to catch MODULE_LIBRARY linkage issues before merge.
historical_context: No prior identical pattern found. This is the first recorded CMake MODULE_LIBRARY linkage failure in Android build.
